response.overview: I Can Do Hard Things: Samantha's Story is a heartfelt documentary that chronicles the remarkable journey of Samantha Gibbs, a young woman with Down syndrome who has transformed her lived experience into a mission of advocacy, education, and inclusion. A Special Olympian, social media personality, cosmetologist-in-training, and a shining example of what's achievable for a young person with Down syndrome with the right support systems, community, and attitude - Samantha proves that the only limits we have are the ones we put on ourselves.
response.tagline: The only limits are the ones we create
response.title: I can do hard things
